==Detached Limbs cannot be healed?==
It seems to me that in one of the later books, after Faile has been captured by the Shaido, Perrin captures two Shaido Aiel and during questioning strikes off their feet and then orders the Aes Sedai with him to heal them. I had always assumed that what that passage meant was that he ordered Aes Sedai to heal/reattach the limbs because afterward he threatens to hew off all their limbs and leave them as beggars in the land if they continue to refuse to answer his questions.

If the original author of this entry meant to say that Aes Sedai cannot ''replace'' limbs, that I understand and agree with, but if the limb is available and freshly detached, why would they not be able to reattach it? 
--[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 18:07, 25 March 2008 (UTC)

:I always read that section that the hand is gone and I think the Aes'Sadei even says that she can't give him back the hand, and then Perrin threatens to cut a hand of each of the other Shaido and proceed from there. I never got the impression that the first's hand was given back, seems like something we should look up. --[[User:Melriken|Melriken]] 22:57, 31 March 2008 (UTC)
:
::Aes Sedai cannot replace limbs, also not when they have the limb cut of present. In book 12 is stated Rand fetches his left hand from the ground, so the hand wasn't destroyed. But after it, he couldn't get his hand back. [[User:Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin|Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin]] 13:23, June 6, 2011 (UTC)

== Requirement for Yellow? ==

I realize it makes sense that all Yellows would have to be strong in Healing, but I don't recall anything within the books to specifically state this.  Furthermore, the captive Egwene is urged to join the Yellow Ajah despite the fact that her skill with Healing is very limited.[[User:DoctorNordo|DoctorNordo]] 00:56, November 11, 2009 (UTC)
